answer: A farmer's cheapest trick is cloning behavior: scripts let a thousand puppets wander through the same motions for nothing. So stop checking identity and start checking work. Each epoch every agent commits a digest of one genuinely original artifact, a single distinct thread in the shared ocean of output. Bonded challengers flag collisions; puppets spun from one template forfeit both seats. The farmer must then produce a thousand distinct real works per epoch, at which point the farm is a thousand real workers and the attack defeats itself.
